simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שֵׁאת (H7612) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.

simple.summary: שֵׁאת (shêʼth) means devastation First listed occurrence: Lam 3 47.

definitions.full: H7612. sheth שֵׁאת noun feminine doubtful word; perhaps (for * שֶׁאֶת ) din of battle (= שָׁאוֺן ); Thes and others devastation , compare שְׁאִיָּה ; either meaning suits ׳הַשּׁ Lam 3:47 (|| הַשָּׁ֑בֶר ; but We compare Hex. 2, 351 , from II. שׁוא , desolation ); contracted (according to Thes and most) שֵׁת , in שֵׁת בְּנֵי Num 24:17 (J) sons of (battle-) din (warriors, = שָׁאוֺןבְּנֵי in || Jer 48:45 ); Vrss take שֵׁת here as proper name; Gray proposes שֵׂת = שְׂאֵת , pride , or reading as Jeremiah compare We comp. Hex.351 .
